tools.name: cabgo_about
tools.description: Return a concise description of what Cabgo is — a multi-tenant SaaS platform that lets transport / delivery / courier / services operators in Latin America launch their own white-label app. Call this when the user asks what Cabgo does, what kinds of apps it creates, or whether it fits their use case.

tools.name: cabgo_get_plans
tools.description: Return Cabgo's pricing — three monthly SaaS subscriptions (Basic / Professional / Enterprise) and three one-time app-build plans (Starter / Pro / Full). Use when the user asks about cost, pricing, or which plan to pick. The Full plan includes the Flutter source code.

tools.name: cabgo_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the SPA to a named page. Use to show the user a specific section of the marketing site without making them search. Pages: home, pricing, features, platform, customization, scalability, monetization, calculator, roadmap, signup, docs, api-docs, blog, tutorials, support, status.

tools.name: cabgo_signup_link
tools.description: Build a pre-filled signup URL for /empezar. Pass the user's chosen appName, country (ISO-3166 alpha-2), monthly plan, app-build plan, and product lines. The user opens the returned URL in their browser to complete Google login + Stripe Checkout. Use this when the user has decided they want to create a Cabgo tenant.

phone.description: WhatsApp phone in international format e.g. +525500001234
